nodes.label: data layer (Retrofit Subsonic API, stores, Room, repositories)
ui layer (Compose NavHost, screens, viewmodels, components)
AuthInterceptor
nodes.rationale: Fresh UUID salt per request with MD5(password+salt); password never logged or sent plain.

nodes.label: PlayerManager singleton
nodes.rationale: Owns one ExoPlayer with app context; scope must stay on Dispatchers.Main because MediaController calls throw on a wrong thread.

nodes.label: PlaybackService / PlayerService (MediaSessionService)
nodes.rationale: Exposes the player via MediaSession for notification, lock-screen, BT, audio focus and gapless playback.

nodes.label: StreamUrlProvider
nodes.rationale: Stream URLs carry per-request auth params (fresh salt, maxBitRate/format).

nodes.label: ScrobblePolicy
nodes.rationale: Submits at 50%-or-4min once per track and ignores seek jumps.

nodes.label: QueueOps
nodes.rationale: Pure index bookkeeping kept separate for unit testing.

nodes.label: ShufflePlan
nodes.rationale: Pure, unit-tested restore rules: unique queueId keys, snapshot on shuffle ON, tail-only permutation, minimum-move restore via moveMediaItem so the current item keeps playing.

nodes.label: QueueStore (DataStore persistence)
nodes.rationale: Persists queue plus shuffle flag, snapshot, keys and key counter so restore survives restart.

nodes.label: MusicDataRepository
nodes.rationale: Interface + Hilt binding so UI never sees DTOs.

nodes.label: CoverArtUrlProvider
nodes.rationale: Stable per-cover salt for cache-friendly cover URLs.

nodes.label: SheetState
nodes.rationale: Owns the Animatable AND a boolean open that only clears after landing exactly on 0, so a closed sheet composes nothing over the screen (fixes invisible touch-eater scrim).

nodes.label: SheetPhysics
nodes.rationale: Pure settle decision: exactly two anchors, fling velocity + 0.35 position threshold, velocity deadzone.

nodes.label: UsageBarMath
nodes.rationale: Every segment including free space is a share of one total; 2% minimum width decided by bytes; difference settled on largest segment so the bar sums to 1.

nodes.label: RowLayout.decide
nodes.rationale: Beside only when text column keeps ~35% of row and wraps to at most 3 lines; otherwise control goes on next line END-aligned.

nodes.label: PagerPeek
nodes.rationale: Reserves endPadding = peek(32) + spacing(12) so next page's first column peeks exactly 32dp; 100dp+ text-column floor.

nodes.label: PlayingScheme
nodes.rationale: Own ~120-line HSL/CIELAB + WCAG engine instead of material-kolor to avoid version-compatibility risk; every contrast pair enforced at construction so readability cannot regress.

nodes.label: DarkToneSpec
nodes.rationale: Seed supplies only the Lab hue; every surface sets its own tone and chroma to avoid oversaturated dark tints.

nodes.label: core/ui Contrast (srgb<->Lab, enforce)
nodes.rationale: enforce() walks tone until ratio passes and falls back to black/white, which always passes.

nodes.label: ThemeMode / migrateStoredTheme / resolveDark
nodes.rationale: AMOLED removed; stored AMOLED or unknown strings migrate to DARK matched by STRING because the enum value no longer exists.

nodes.label: VusicColors
nodes.rationale: Members became @Composable getters onto the active Material scheme so all call sites became theme-aware without being edited (Light theme previously rendered dark due to 135 hardcoded literals).

nodes.label: CrashGuard
nodes.rationale: Absorbs non-fatal background failures on app-level scopes and non-main threads while main-thread crashes keep the platform default so real UI bugs stay visible.

nodes.label: SongPagerSection
nodes.rationale: Shared pager (4 rows/page, dots, Play all) so Forgotten favorites and Quick picks render identically.

nodes.label: TopLevelTitleBar
nodes.rationale: Fixed 48dp row, one inset handler, one padding, one typography so every top-level screen matches by construction; takes no status inset of its own because the scaffold already provides it.

nodes.label: SettingControlRow
nodes.rationale: Text left weight(1f), control right vertically centred, 16dp min gap, text capped at 3 lines.

nodes.label: LocalMiniClearance
nodes.rationale: Replaces hardcoded 160dp bottom paddings with 24dp breathing room + animated card claim so items scroll behind the floating mini player.

nodes.label: MiniPlayer
nodes.rationale: Overlay inside content area (not bottomBar) so content scrolls behind it; hoisted into full-window box with no IME inset so the keyboard draws over it.

nodes.label: WorkManager download work
nodes.rationale: Unique work with dataSync foreground notification, Cancel and Wi-Fi-only constraints.

nodes.label: CacheWriter-based prefetch
nodes.rationale: Stable Media3 cache keys shared with playback, cancellation on queue changes, Wi-Fi-only gate.

nodes.label: Radio auto-DJ
nodes.rationale: Similar->genre->random fallthrough with session-scoped no-repeat memory and trigger-guarded appends within 2 of the end with quiet backoff.

nodes.label: EncryptedSharedPreferences credentials store
nodes.rationale: AES256_GCM + StateFlow; NavHost start destination reacts to login state so no restart is needed.

nodes.label: DataStore Preferences settings
nodes.rationale: Self-signed toggle read live by a dynamic X509TrustManager inside the shared OkHttpClient so it applies without restart.

nodes.label: Offline mode + Room JSON cache
nodes.rationale: Stale-while-revalidate cached library reads; queued offline scrobbles/stars replayed with original timestamps.

nodes.label: ReplayGain + crossfade
nodes.rationale: Crossfade implemented as a safe volume ramp.

nodes.label: proguard-rules.pro
nodes.rationale: Hand-written ruleset for Retrofit, kotlinx.serialization, Hilt/Dagger, Room, Media3, WorkManager, Coil and service/widget entry points; release degrades to unsigned APK when keystore absent so CI needs no secrets.

nodes.label: Motion object (Fast 150 / Normal 220 / Slow 300, 28ms stagger, durationScale hook)
nodes.rationale: Single Motion object so all motion is consistent and the system animation setting can zero every duration.

nodes.label: PlayerService (MediaLibraryService)
nodes.rationale: Converted from MediaSessionService to MediaLibraryService to support Android Auto browse tree while keeping phone behavior unchanged.

nodes.label: Android Auto browse tree (4 root tabs)
nodes.rationale: Exactly 4 root tabs (Home, Library, Favorites, Downloads) to keep the car UI shallow and paged.

nodes.label: DEFAULT_SESSION_AND_LIBRARY_COMMANDS fix
nodes.rationale: A custom onConnect replacing default commands with session-only commands stripped the library command set, causing PERMISSION_DENIED (-4) on every browse call.

nodes.label: PlayerManager.adoptExternalQueue
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the Auto queue into PlayerManager without touching the controller; start index self-heals through the queue-key transition listener.

nodes.label: Home screen widget (compact 4x1 / large 4x2)
nodes.rationale: Rendering always goes through persisted SharedPreferences state so the widget is meaningful with the app dead; event-driven updates with a key guard avoid RemoteViews spam.

nodes.label: MediaSession.Callback.onPlaybackResumption
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds the persisted queue (same stream/download URIs) and restores paused so widget Play after a process kill resumes instead of failing.

nodes.label: Commit-on-drop queue reorder (QueueCommit)
nodes.rationale: onMove firing every drag frame caused full-list recompose, IPC moveMediaItem, DataStore writes and auto-scroll fighting the gesture (18.5% janky frames, p99 101ms); onMove now mutates only a local displayOrder copy with one commitOrder() on drop.

nodes.label: Queue sheet redesign
nodes.rationale: Top row reduced to source title + Radio badge + Save; immediate-drag handle without long-press delay; pinned bottom bar in sync with Now Playing.

nodes.label: Mini-player drag-clear with undo
nodes.rationale: Offset+fade in graphicsLayer avoids recomposition; past 160px commits clearWithUndo() with an undo snackbar restoring queue, item and position paused.

nodes.label: ABI splits (arm64-v8a + x86_64) and resConfigs("en")
nodes.rationale: No removable code or deps found, so wins are packaging-only: arm64 APK -10.2% file size, arsc download 96,314 -> 13,798 bytes.

nodes.label: collectAsStateWithLifecycle migration (94 sites / 17 files)
nodes.rationale: Collections now pause below STARTED; mini-player ring keeps direct position.value sampling in a 4 Hz draw-phase loop by design (no recomposition, playback-gated).

nodes.label: Hand-written baseline-prof.txt + :baselineprofile module
nodes.rationale: Macrobenchmark would profile the login screen, so the profile is hand-written with exact verified methods; Groovy DSL because KTS accessors don't resolve for that plugin.

nodes.label: Debug-only StrictMode
nodes.rationale: Caught 3 main-thread disk reads, all fixed: EncryptedSharedPreferences creation, OkHttp TLS init + SimpleCache SQLite open, widget DataStore load.

nodes.label: core/ui/RefreshRate pure selector
nodes.rationale: Highest same-resolution rate for AUTO/MAX, nearest-to-60 for STANDARD; higher-rate-at-lower-resolution never wins. Applied via public window hints only because Surface.setFrameRate has no public accessor for the activity window in compileSdk 34.

nodes.label: Release keystore keystore/vusic-release.jks
nodes.rationale: Untracked and gitignored; validity to 2054-03-02 (~27.4 years, over the 25-year minimum) because replacing it would break updates.

nodes.label: EncryptedSharedPreferences credential storage
nodes.rationale: Credentials live only in EncryptedSharedPreferences; creation moved to lazy prefs + IO preload() behind the ready gate to avoid a main-thread read and login flash.

nodes.label: VLog / RedactingHttpLogger (BuildConfig.DEBUG-gated)
nodes.rationale: Release logging is compile-time off so no credentials or logs leak.

nodes.label: github.com/vyrdez/vusic
nodes.rationale: Published public under GPL-3.0-only after rewriting history to strip personal data and build artifacts (218 MiB -> 585 KiB).

nodes.label: .github/workflows/build.yml
nodes.rationale: JDK 17, preinstalled Android SDK, assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest lint, no secrets, no release signing.

nodes.label: SheetPhysics / SheetState settle fix
nodes.rationale: settle() read anim.value while snapTo had only queued its coroutine, so releases were judged on stale positions; fixed with a synchronous dragValue mirror and POSITION_THRESHOLD lowered 0.35 -> 0.18.

nodes.label: MiniPlayerGesture.classify
nodes.rationale: Pure classifier with real axis lock (vertical wins ties), fling-aware thresholds, LEFT=previous / RIGHT=next / DOWN=clear / UP=open; first/last track with repeat off springs back.

nodes.label: OfflineBanner
nodes.rationale: Was an overlay in the same Box as the NavHost painting over titles; moved to an AnimatedVisibility(expandVertically) row in the shared Column so one change fixes every screen.

nodes.label: PlaylistOrdering (sort/filter)
nodes.rationale: Index-based pure sort/filter; sorted or filtered lists are read-only and removal resolves the track by id against the stored order, never the visible row. Regex hoisted to a private val to avoid compiling thousands per keystroke.

nodes.label: StorageLimits.cacheSteps / CacheSizePolicy
nodes.rationale: Sliders used device-max steps while stored values clamp to 5 GB stream / 1 GB image, causing the "5 GB plateau"; cacheSteps intersects real cache sizes with the device so it is never empty.

nodes.label: App logo (eighth note) and ic_stat_vusic
nodes.rationale: Launcher now uses the app's own mark (Icons.Default.MusicNote) centred in the 66 dp safe zone of the 108 dp canvas, matching the wordmark and notification icon.

nodes.label: docs/reference/phase8, before-8, after-8 captures
nodes.rationale: Reference material is gitignored; no screenshots or third-party captures are published.

nodes.label: MainActivity
nodes.rationale: Only exported activity (launcher); applies refresh-rate window hints on create/resume/config-change and live on setting change.

nodes.label: FeishinApp (Application)
nodes.rationale: IO warmup of Hilt singletons in onCreate (cache first) to remove main-thread disk reads; lazy Provider<ImageLoader> moves the blocking DataStore read out of onCreate.

nodes.label: QueueHandoff
nodes.rationale: A LazyColumn's default overscroll effect consumes the whole drag at the first item, so the sheet handoff saw available.y == 0; a pass-through OverscrollEffect plus a pure QueueHandoff decision taken in onPreScroll lets the sheet own the delta.

nodes.label: CacheSizePolicy
nodes.rationale: The 5 GB limit survived because STREAM_SIZES_MB, the table the slider derives from, ended at 5120 MB; the table now runs to 100 GB and the cache stops growing below 1 GB free instead of deleting.

nodes.label: MobileDataPolicy
nodes.rationale: The old auto-cache gate compared the transport NAME so a metered hotspot counted as free; the rule now uses the real NET_CAPABILITY_NOT_METERED capability, never while offline, never while roaming.

nodes.label: OfflineBanner
nodes.rationale: The Search screen emitted its offline hint as a sibling before the fillMaxSize Column, painting it half-clipped behind the search pill; a shared banner with clipToBounds and real height is used by both Nav and Search.

nodes.label: QueueOps
nodes.rationale: Positional removal plus a remembered dismiss state replayed across settling recompositions removed 6 songs per swipe; removal by stable queue item id with an AtomicBoolean guard is idempotent.

nodes.label: PlayerManager
nodes.rationale: BoundedQueuePlayer exposes at most 100 items, so applyOrder's count check failed and fell back to ~500 moveMediaItem IPC calls that crashed the Bluetooth AVRCP daemon; an in-memory MediaItem cache allows one atomic setMediaItems reorder.

nodes.label: QueueStore
nodes.rationale: DataStore chosen over Room because there are zero relational queries and QueueStore already existed; a single small JSON blob needs no migration.

nodes.label: PlayerService
nodes.rationale: The service, not the UI, drives scrobbling so it survives the app process.

nodes.label: MetadataCache
nodes.rationale: Already in the Room schema, so cache-first Library tabs needed no migration.

nodes.label: CachePolicy
nodes.rationale: Per-key throttle ~3 min, one-shot force per pull-to-refresh, and a failed attempt still consumes its window.

nodes.label: MusicRepository
nodes.rationale: addToPlaylist/createPlaylist batch Subsonic calls at 100 song IDs per request so large artists (500+ songs) work.

nodes.label: NetworkModule
nodes.rationale: API client gets 5 s connect / 10 s read / retryOnConnectionFailure(false) so slow connections fail fast into the cache-first path.

nodes.label: MessageHost
nodes.rationale: The SnackbarHost lived in the Scaffold content slot while the mini player was hoisted above the scaffold, so snackbars painted underneath; MessageHost is placed after the mini player in the NavHost Box for correct z-order.

nodes.label: DownloadWorker
nodes.rationale: publishProgress wrote to Room every 64 KB chunk, invalidating observeAll and recomposing the UI thousands of times; progress writes are throttled to ~2/sec and notification updates to ~1/sec. Returning Result.retry() on stop keeps WorkManager rescheduling.

nodes.label: Offline Cover Store
nodes.rationale: Persistent download_covers keyed by coverArtId and de-duplicated across tracks, with reference-counted deletion so cover files are pruned only when no remaining downloaded song uses them.

nodes.label: LoginScreen
nodes.rationale: A failed attempt replaced LoginUi with a fresh state dropping busy/message; the form now keeps URL/username/password, shows an inline error card plus snackbar, and maps specific friendly messages per failure class.

nodes.label: AppNav
nodes.rationale: Gates the nav graph on AuthRepository.ready so there is no login flash.

nodes.label: AuthRepository
nodes.rationale: ready flips true after the credentials preload finishes on IO (lazy EncryptedSharedPreferences creation + read) so no disk reads happen on the main thread at startup.

nodes.label: NavRules
nodes.rationale: shouldShowNowPlaying only shows the overlay while a track exists, fixing the stray 'Nothing playing' text after Clear.

nodes.label: RadioFetcher
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes error from empty so transient failures retry with backoff instead of claiming an empty library.

nodes.label: RadioMemory
nodes.rationale: Session set plus 50-song rolling history keeps repeats out and caps artist spread at 2 in a row.

nodes.label: FavoritesStore
nodes.rationale: Every star goes through it with reactive refresh via shared events so the Favorites tab stays fresh.

nodes.label: StableCacheKey
nodes.rationale: Media3 keys the cache by full URI and stream URLs carry a fresh salt per request, so nothing could hit; keeping only endpoint path plus id/maxBitRate/format makes prefetch and playback share keys.

nodes.label: PlaybackProgress
nodes.rationale: Unknown duration exposed as 0 collapsed the slider range to 0f..1f and saturated position; pure math maps unknown to 0 progress and '--:--'.

nodes.label: BoundedQueuePlayer
nodes.rationale: Publishes a 100-item window around the current track so external clients never receive a 3,000-item queue.

nodes.label: LRCLIB Client
nodes.rationale: Candidate scoring, multi-variant search, duration comparison and fair-use caching.

nodes.label: LyricsRepository
nodes.rationale: Sources run in the user's order with a 9s per-call timeout and 15s budget per song; a provider that throws is skipped instead of aborting the chain.

nodes.label: LrclibMatcher
nodes.rationale: Duration-first candidate scoring (±3 s) accepts matches across romanized and kanji artist spellings.

nodes.label: LyricsScrollEngine
nodes.rationale: animateContentSize plus differing font sizes changed item heights mid-scroll and caused jitter; constant item metrics with draw-phase emphasis and a 35% viewport anchor fix it.

nodes.label: LyricsTabCorrections
nodes.rationale: lastScrolledIndex lived inside SyncedLyricsList which AnimatedContent disposes, so re-entry forced a SNAP that double-applied the anchor offset; hoisting it and unifying scroll math into computeLyricsScrollOffset gives 0 px drift.

nodes.label: Romanizer
nodes.rationale: Kuromoji IPADIC morphological analysis with 6-rule token joining keeps particles separate while joining verb/adj endings and auxiliaries; provider romanization is sanity-checked to reject empty or CJK-polluted strings.

nodes.label: LyricsMenuSheet
nodes.rationale: Reuses the standard surfaceContainerLow container matching the Song menu sheet, with high-contrast controls meeting WCAG AA.

nodes.label: SettingsStore
nodes.rationale: Old priority key stays in DataStore and is ignored; no migration from the old priority switch.

nodes.label: Device Files (Local Music)
nodes.rationale: Server-only actions like scrobble, star, download and remote playlists are hidden for local tracks in a mixed queue.
